'''"Engine Oil" Keratho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Ila Spaceport]], he sold various [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components.
